description: This is a PHP unit test class for the ApplicantController within the Recruitment plugin of OrangeHRM. It tests the applicant submission process, including validation and database updates, for various scenarios.

classes.name: ApplicantControllerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ApplicantController responsible for handling applicant submissions in the recruitment process.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by loading fixtures and setting up database state.

methods.name: testHandle
methods.description: Main test method that simulates applicant submissions with various data sets and validates the results.

methods.name: dataProviderForController
methods.description: Provides multiple sets of input data and expected outcomes for the testHandle method.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up test fixtures and cleans database tables before each test.

methods.name: testHandle
methods.description: Performs tests on the applicant application handling process, including validation, database insertion, and response validation.

methods.name: dataProviderForController
methods.description: Returns an array of test cases with input parameters and expected results for data-driven testing.
